symbolic.source: Landau & Lifshitz, Fluid Mechanics, 2nd English ed., §24 (oscillations of a viscous fluid); re-derived here, not transcribed
symbolic.half_space_profile: u = U0 exp(-y/delta) cos(omega t - y/delta)
symbolic.finite_depth_profile: u = Re{U0 sinh(m(H-y))/sinh(mH) exp(i omega t)}, m = (1+i)/delta
